collection.description: A young child asks how babies begin and grow.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks how babies begin and grow.

choices.label: Share a Spiritual or Magical Belief.
Answer Briefly and Invite Later Questions.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a trusted adult, explains that babies grow in a uterus after a sperm and egg join.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks how a baby gets food while growing, beginning another gentle lesson.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a feast, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (adult) compares growing babies with seeds and eggs while noting the differences.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) learns that different living things reproduce in different ways.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) describes a family tradition as a belief, not established fact.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks whether everyone believes the same story and learns that they do not.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (adult) gives a simple true answer and promises more detail when wanted.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) is satisfied for now and returns to playing.
